sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Zimbabwe visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Zimbabwe. You can apply online for an eVisa before travelling, or get a visa on arrival.

sections.heading: Zimbabwe visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports may need to apply in advance, depending on their nationality. If you're also visiting Zambia, ask us whether the KAZA visa is available for your trip.

sections.heading: Zimbabwe eVisa or visa on arrival?
sections.text: Applying for an eVisa in advance means less waiting on arrival and certainty before you fly. If you're also visiting Zambia, ask us about the KAZA visa.

sections.heading: Zimbabwe visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Zimbabwe visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Zimbabwe.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a visa for Zimbabwe?
faqs.a: Yes. You can apply online for an eVisa in advance or get a visa on arrival.

faqs.q: How long does a Zimbabwe visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Zimbabwe visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Zimbabwe visa application and submit it for you.
